      "rationale": "Mempool acceptance logic, package relay, and eviction policies are not substantively modified."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,

      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "No changes to block template construction, mining RPCs, or the Mining interface."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies net_processing.cpp to drop transactions upfront at P2P deserialization if they have zero inputs/outputs or exceed the 4M weight budget.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Enforcing upfront deserialization bounds directly protects P2P message processing from allocating unbounded memory before validation runs. The PR alters P2P behavior so that empty or oversized transactions are dropped at the transport/deserialization stage rather than rejected after validation."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp are mechanical migrations to span-based witness accessors.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "RPC endpoints, arguments, output formats, and interface behaviors remain unchanged."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds benchmarks in src/bench/block_deserialize.cpp and a fuzz harness in src/test/fuzz/script_witness.cpp specific to the new serialization.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The test additions and harness updates directly support the CScriptWitness refactor rather than changing test runner infrastructure or general frameworks."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/bitcoin-tx.cpp only via mechanical scripted diff.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Tool interfaces and features are not modified."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Extends src/serialize.h and src/streams.h with deserialization helpers specifically for transaction and witness bounds.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The serialization utility additions are ancillary helpers for consensus/validation primitives rather than general node infrastructure changes."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Overhauls CScriptWitness storage and bounding logic in src/primitives/transaction.h, src/script/script.h, and block deserialization.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.74,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Addresses a validation-time resource exhaustion vector where pathological 4 MB blocks with millions of tiny witness elements consumed over 100 MiB memory and took nearly 300 ms to deserialize. Benchmarks demonstrate deserialization memory dropping from 106.8 MiB to 3.8 MiB and peak memory dropping from 182.2 MiB to 7.8 MiB."
